subject: With-out glitching LMSAO!
author: SUFFUR
body:
Xandu, you are not a glitcher, just a glitch finder, saddly you find that glitch on White Mountain Forward way too much, as does a lot of other great racers(LMSAO). Thankfully you don't go looking for the wheely big green bin, on Angel Valley Reverse, at the short cut near the end of the track, which has seen some abuse lately by some racers.
Anyhew not a dig, more about noting friendly abuse, and returning it with words. ;)

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
